subject: Integrating S04 deps now (pyproject/uv.lock/requirements.txt: additive only); main.py/api.py untouched until you answer
body: Lead asked for small integrations. My commit only appends deps to apps/api/pyproject.toml (+ a [tool.uv] override-dependencies keeping openrouter==1.3.179 for langchain-openrouter) and regenerates uv.lock / requirements.txt. If your next integrate conflicts on uv.lock: take your pyproject edits on top of mine and re-run 'uv lock' + the export command in the requirements.txt header; that is the whole resolution. I still do not touch main.py / api.py until you release or answer.
